summary: Stellantis marque DS Automobiles is the title partner (team name); eleven further partners are on the club's own current partner roster on dspenske.com: TotalEnergies, Penske Media Corporation, Mouser, Molex, KYOCERA AVX, TTI, Syensqo, Yahoo, NEOM-SRMG and Lockton. Car placements are not modelled by the kit schema, so these are recorded as front (title partner) and partner.
